title: Eight cyclic fields with a 359-operation pair-table cube

claims.statement: The explicit 8-field degree-125 cyclic encoder with extended quadratic-residue parity and its radius-125 depth-budget list decoder on 2000 BSC(1/10) uses have average block error at most 436495425282132852521613780993/6250000000000000000000000000000.
The same bsc-ops-v1 decoder executes at most W=153258719451356100123736316521034353495280952024214441 primitives on every received word, with W<=2^(2229325/12618).

experiments.purpose: Check field and QR geometry, 359-operation cube schedule and exact work (0), ten signed pair cutoffs (1), 231 child weights with the shorter rank prefix (2), and the exact occupancy/error bound (3).
